citations.narrative:
The licensee interfered with and verbally abused an APHIS official, preventing the inspector from completing the
inspection. The APHIS official arrived at the facility to conduct an unannounced routine inspection on 7/27/26 at
approximately 9:45am. Approximately twenty-five minutes into the inspection, the inspector inquired about the condition of
a raccoon exhibiting an apparent abnormal behavior in order to determine compliance with the Animal Welfare
Regulations. Mr. Delaney became angry and stated that this was ridiculous. Mr. Delaney loudly, aggressively, and
repeatedly accused the inspector of making things up, looking for things to cite, and being “nitpicky.” He repeatedly raised
his voice, shouted profanity, and cut off the inspector, not allowing any questions to be asked to determine compliance.
Mr. Delaney accused the inspector of lying and “making shit up”. The inspector asked Mr. Delaney to stop speaking in this
manner and let him know that if it didn’t stop, he would be cited for interference with the inspection process. Mr. Delaney
continued to use profanities and insult the inspector, saying that the inspector was “fucking ridiculous” and an “idiot”.
When Mr. Delaney’s wife arrived, Mr. Delaney said to his wife, “You wanna deal with this fucking lunatic,” referring to the
inspector.
As the inspector attempted to continue the inspection with Mr. Delaney’s wife, Mr. Delaney continued to shout, use
profanity, and accuse the inspector of lying, making things up, and looking for things to cite. When Mr. Delaney’s
aggression, verbal abuse, and harassing comments continued, the inspector informed Mr. Delaney and his wife that they
were stopping the inspection. The inspector then left the facility.
When licensees interfere with, verbally abuse, or harass an APHIS official in the course of carrying out their duties, it
prevents APHIS from inspecting the licensee’s facility, animals, and records to ensure compliance with the Animal
Welfare Act and Regulations. A licensee shall not interfere with, threaten, abuse (including verbally abuse), or harass any
APHIS official in the course of carrying out his or her duties.
To be corrected from the date of this inspection forward.
No exit interview was conducted.
